stories.title: La. judge clears pro athletes to return to LSU
stories.summary: Dae'Quan Wright and Zxavian Harris are currently cleared to return to college football after brief stints in the NFL, according to a judge's orders issued Thursday evening, setting up a dramatic showdown between the SEC and LSU.

stories.title: Lombardi resigns as UNC GM amid investigation
stories.summary: Michael Lombardi resigned as the GM of the UNC football team, which he had joined when Bill Belichick was hired in late 2024.

stories.title: UMass ends 16-game skid with win over Rutgers
stories.summary: Pop Watson III passed for 197 yards and three touchdowns as UMass ended a 16-game losing streak with a 37-21 win over Rutgers in the season opener for both teams Thursday night.

stories.title: Kanter Freedom files suit vs. Sky, Wintrust Arena
stories.summary: Enes Kanter Freedom is suing the Chicago Sky and the owners of Wintrust Arena, alleging in a 15-page complaint filed Thursday that his First Amendment rights were violated when he was removed from a Sky home game last month.

stories.title: Buffs rally late, block Ga. Tech's walk-off FG try
stories.summary: Freshman QB Julian Lewis led a clutch two-minute drill to put Colorado ahead, and the Buffaloes secured a 14-13 win by blocking Georgia Tech's 45-yard field goal attempt as time expired Thursday night.
